readerCopy.body: A feeling that has been buried for a long time may not arrive gently once something finally brings it into the open. When the Moon conjoins Pluto, resentment, grief, fear, jealousy, or a private truth can change the emotional balance of a relationship or group quickly. Intensity does not make the disclosure meaningless, and discomfort does not require the old arrangement to be restored immediately. The important part is what the information changes now that it can no longer be kept underneath the interaction.
